title: Abilene Festival Brings Western Swing, Blues And 90s Rock To One Stage - NewsBreak
text:
By Rudy Fernandez ,
4 hours ago
Some music festivals make you pick a lane. Mark Powell appears to have invited the whole highway.
Country music, Western swing, blues, classic rock, and 90s alternative rock are coming together for the 16th annual Outlaws & Legends Music Festival , March 19 20, 2027, at The Backporch of Texas in Abilene.
Download the KEAN Mobile App Now
I looked through this lineup and thought, How am I supposed to sit still through all of that?
Mark is opening the gates to the ranch he shares with his family, welcoming music lovers for two outdoor days filled with old favorites, discoveries, and plenty of reasons to gather your besties.
Photo by: Mark Powell/Outlaws & Legends
Who Is Coming to Outlaws & Legends in 2027?
Here’s your guide to the artists on the lineup. I didn’t list them in the order of performance but rather in the order they appear on the Outlaws & Legends flyer.
Ryan Bingham and The Texas Gentlemen – Americana, country, and roots rock. Bingham’s gravelly voice and road-worn storytelling meet the musical firepower of The Texas Gentlemen. The Oscar- and Grammy-winning songwriter brings a sound that travels comfortably between country, blues, and rock.
Buddy Guy – Chicago electric blues . We are talking about a living blues legend whose guitar playing helped inspire generations of rock musicians. Known for Damn Right, I’ve Got the Blues, Guy brings a musical history lesson you can feel clear down to your boots.
Mark Powell – Texas Country and Red Dirt . Our host is also an artist with deep West Texas roots, pairing traditional country foundations with an energetic live show. You may know songs such as This Bar Needs a Town and Keep It Country. This weekend, he’s wearing both the performer’s hat and the host’s hat.
Kevin Fowler – Texas Country and Honky-Tonk . Mark s longtime friend is coming back, and Fowler fans know what that means: big sing-alongs and a good time. Beer, Bait and Ammo helped make him a Texas favorite. Bring your singing voice.
Everclear – 90s alternative rock. Here comes a different kind of sing-along. With songs including Santa Monica, Father of Mine, and I Will Buy You a New Life, Everclear supplies the guitar-driven soundtrack many of us remember from the radio in the 90s.
Foghat – 70s Classic Rock, Blues Rock, and Boogie. Two words: Slow Ride. Foghat’s blues-powered rock also gave us their familiar version of I Just Want to Make Love to You. If your festival wardrobe includes an old concert shirt, this might be your moment.
Asleep at the Wheel – plays Western Swing and traditional country. Ray Benson and company have spent decades carrying Western swing to audiences around the world. Their blend of country, jazz, and dance-floor rhythm is a reminder that Texas music has always had plenty of room to swing.
Ray Wylie Hubbard – Americana, roots music, and blues-soaked songwriting. The man behind Snake Farm brings grit, humor, and stories with some miles on them. Hubbard is one of those artists who can make you laugh, lean in, and think all within the same song.
The Wilder Blue – Country rock with five-part harmonies. Led by Zane Williams, this Texas band mixes storytelling, adventurous musicianship, and beautifully layered voices. If you enjoy the place where country meets harmony-rich rock, put a star beside this name.
Rick Trevino – 90s Country with Texas and bilingual roots. Trevino s career includes English- and Spanish-language recordings and the chart-topping Running Out of Reasons to Run. He brings another familiar voice for those of us who love our 90s country.
Kin Faux – Fiddle-driven Texas Red Dirt Country. This San Antonio-based band combines rich harmonies, fiery fiddle playing, and rock energy. Their influences include Charlie Daniels, Alabama, and Restless Heart. That ought to give you an idea of the musical neighborhood.
The Reeves Brothers – Traditional Honky-Tonk Country. Brothers Matt and Cole Reeves lean into the kind of country that belongs on a jukebox beside Merle Haggard. Their roots run through their dad’s honky-tonk, and their sound gives classic-country lovers plenty to smile about.
Grayson Russell – Southern-Rock, Country, and Americana. You may recognize Russell from his acting work, including Talladega Nights. He’s also a singer-songwriter with releases such as Corn and Kerosene and Go Cry Somewhere Else. Here’s a chance to get acquainted with his musical side.
Ella Powell – is a country artist carrying on a family tradition. Mark’s daughter returns after appearing last year, balancing college life with music. Her recording credits include The Social Page from her Ella EP. As a dad, I have a soft spot for watching somebody’s child find her own voice.
Click here to view photo gallery A Big Country Weekend That Gives Back.
There’s another reason this festival matters to me. Festival proceeds support Boots & Salutes, a nonprofit serving military veterans, Gold Star families, and first responders. According to Mark Powell, more than $4 million has been donated to local charities through the festival. My dad served 26 years in the United States Air Force. Seeing music bring people together while helping military families gives this gathering extra meaning.
Chaz and Fearless Will Be There, Too.
You’ll also see a couple of familiar radio faces handling some stage introductions. Chaz McGuire, from Rock 108, 100.7 KOOL FM, and The Ranch 92.5, will be joining the festivities. So will yours truly, Rudy Fearless Fernandez, from KEAN-105 and The Ranch 92.5. Getting to help welcome these artists to an Abilene stage? Yes, please!
Christmas Tickets and a March Getaway
If somebody asks what you want for Christmas, here’s an answer: Outlaws & Legends weekend passes. A two-day pass lets you enjoy both festival days.
Here’s a reason to act soon: discounted advance ticket sales end tomorrow, Friday, November 6, 2026, at 10 p.m. Central, according to the festival website.
Want to make a weekend of it? Explore the RV and camping information, package options, availability, and rules before booking. Ask organizers about tent camping, Thursday arrival, Sunday departure, and whether a Sunday church service is planned for 2027.
Then put in for your time off. Gather the family and your besties. Give yourselves something to look forward to after the Christmas decorations come down.
Start at OutlawsAndLegends.com for tickets and festival information.
Country boots, a rock-and-roll shirt, or both I’ll see you at The Backporch of Texas.
